entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: A remote continent in Dominaria's southern hemisphere ravaged by warfare between the Brothers' War and the Ice Age, setting of Fallen Empires.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Sarpadia lies.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures created by the Order of the Ebon Hand who rebelled and came to hold dominion over all of Sarpadia.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Creations of the elves of Havenwood who overthrew them and remained shambling brutes.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The black-aligned Sarpadian empire that created the thrulls and fell to their rebellion.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: The human nation of Sarpadia, destroyed by orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: The merfolk empire of the Old Voda Sea, conquered by homarids.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: A tremendous northern forest, home to the elves, which fell to thallids.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: A huge mountain range in southern Sarpadia and home of dwarves.

entities.name: Dwarven Stronghold
entities.description: Fortress of the Sarpadian Mountain dwarves, destroyed by orcs and goblins.

entities.name: Orcs and goblins
entities.description: A chaos-driven army that destroyed the dwarven kingdom and Icatia; later destroyed by thrulls.

entities.name: Tchokta empire
entities.description: An ancient Sarpadian empire demanding sapient sacrifices, ripped apart by the progenitors of the later empires.

entities.name: N'ciczli
entities.description: The last war priest of the Tchokta, summoned away by planeswalkers and believed to have become a god.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Activated the Golgothian Sylex, cooling the world's climate.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact whose activation rapidly cooled the climate of the world.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: An antarctic race of crustaceans that conquered Vodalia and later migrated to Terisiare.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who aided the orc and goblin forces against Icatia.

entities.name: Farrelite Cult
entities.description: A cult whose subterfuge weakened Icatia before the final attacks.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Person after whom the settlement of Scarza is presumably named.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: A human who tried to defend the Dwarven Stronghold.

entities.name: Kaylen
entities.description: A dwarf who tried to defend the Dwarven Stronghold.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: A blue primeval dragon once housed in an ancient merfolk tomb, Dromar's Cavern.

entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: A goddess of the merfolk with a temple in Vodalia.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion during which Phyrexians were rumored to meet resistance from Sarpadian thrulls.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders rumored to be defeated by the thrulls.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Possibly perfected the secret of creating thrulls.

entities.name: Evincars
entities.description: Phyrexian rulers who may have perfected thrull creation.

entities.name: Fallen Empires
entities.description: The expansion that tells most of Sarpadia's story.

events.summary: After Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex the climate cools, crops fail, and strife breaks out between former allies; homarids encroach on merfolk waters.
events.quote: After Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , the climate of the entire world rapidly cooled.

events.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
events.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

events.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
events.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

events.summary: The thrulls destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs and keep evolving, content with their isolation.
events.quote: the goblins were destroyed by the thrulls

events.summary: Homarids migrate to Terisiare, where they cause flooding, later fading away.
events.quote: the Voda Sea continued to be dominated by homarids

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Phyrexians are rumored to be defeated by thrulls on Sarpadia.
events.quote: it was rumored that the metal demons of Phyrexia met insurmountable resistance from the thrulls in Sarpadia

relations.note: The Ebon Hand fell to their own creations
relations.quote: the fall of the Ebon Hand at the hands of their creations, the thrulls

relations.note: Thrulls rebelled and toppled the Ebon Hand
relations.quote: the fall of the Ebon Hand at the hands of their creations, the thrulls
the whole of the Vodalian empire was conquered by homarid forces

relations.note: Aided the orcs and goblins against Icatia
relations.quote: aided by the planeswalker Tevesh Szat

relations.note: Thrulls destroyed goblins and wiped out the last orcs
relations.quote: finally wiped out the last of the orcs

relations.note: Forest in the north of the continent
relations.quote: Havenwood - a tremendous forest in the north, home to the elves.
